title: No Poverty
summary: End poverty in all its forms everywhere.
target_definition: Ensure that all people have equal rights to economic resources and access to basic services, property, natural resources, appropriate technology and financial services.

title: Zero Hunger
summary: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture.
target_definition: Ensure sustainable food production systems and resilient agricultural practices.

title: Good Health and Well-being
summary: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.
target_definition: Achieve universal health coverage, including access to quality essential health-care services.

title: Quality Education
summary: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.
target_title: Relevant skills for employment and decent work
target_definition: Increase the number of young people and adults with relevant skills, including technical and vocational skills, for employment, decent jobs and entrepreneurship.

title: Gender Equality
summary: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls.
target_definition: Enhance the use of enabling technology, in particular information and communications technology, to promote the empowerment of women.

title: Clean Water and Sanitation
summary: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.
target_definition: Improve water quality by reducing pollution, eliminating dumping and minimizing release of hazardous chemicals and materials.

title: Affordable and Clean Energy
summary: Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all.
target_definition: Double the global rate of improvement in energy efficiency.

title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
summary: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all.
target_title: Productivity through diversification, technology and innovation
target_definition: Achieve higher levels of economic productivity through diversification, technological upgrading and innovation.

title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
summary: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation.
target_definition: Enhance scientific research and upgrade the technological capabilities of industrial sectors, including by encouraging innovation.

title: Reduced Inequalities
summary: Reduce inequality within and among countries.
target_definition: Empower and promote the social, economic and political inclusion of all, irrespective of status.

title: Sustainable Cities and Communities
summary: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.
target_definition: Enhance inclusive and sustainable urbanization and capacity for participatory, integrated and sustainable human settlement planning and management.

title: Responsible Consumption and Production
summary: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.
target_definition: Encourage companies to adopt sustainable practices and to integrate sustainability information into their reporting cycle.

title: Climate Action
summary: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.
target_definition: Improve education, awareness-raising and human and institutional capacity on climate change mitigation, adaptation, impact reduction and early warning.

title: Life Below Water
summary: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas and marine resources for sustainable development.
target_definition: Sustainably manage and protect marine and coastal ecosystems to avoid significant adverse impacts.

title: Life on Land
summary: Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably manage forests, combat desertification, and halt and reverse land degradation and halt biodiversity loss.
target_definition: Take urgent and significant action to reduce the degradation of natural habitats and halt the loss of biodiversity.

title: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
summary: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels.
target_definition: Develop effective, accountable and transparent institutions at all levels.

title: Partnerships for the Goals
summary: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development.
target_definition: Enhance North-South, South-South and triangular regional and international cooperation on access to science, technology and innovation.

title: No Poverty
summary: End poverty in all its forms everywhere.
target_title: Reduce poverty in all its dimensions
target_definition: Reduce at least by half the proportion of people living in poverty in all its dimensions according to national definitions.

title: Zero Hunger
summary: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture.
target_title: Invest in rural infrastructure and agricultural research
target_definition: Increase investment in rural infrastructure, agricultural research and extension services, technology development and plant and livestock gene banks.

title: Good Health and Well-being
summary: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.
target_title: Reduce premature mortality and promote mental health
target_definition: Reduce premature mortality from non-communicable diseases and promote mental health and well-being.

title: Quality Education
summary: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.
target_title: Equal access to technical, vocational and higher education
target_definition: Ensure equal access for women and men to affordable and quality technical, vocational and tertiary education, including university.

title: Gender Equality
summary: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls.
target_definition: Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making.

title: Clean Water and Sanitation
summary: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.
target_definition: Substantially increase water-use efficiency and ensure sustainable withdrawals and supply of freshwater to address water scarcity.

title: Affordable and Clean Energy
summary: Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all.
target_title: Increase the share of renewable energy
target_definition: Increase substantially the share of renewable energy in the global energy mix.

title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
summary: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all.
target_title: Full employment and decent work for all
target_definition: Achieve full and productive employment and decent work for all, with equal pay for work of equal value.

title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
summary: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation.
target_title: Access to information and communications technology
target_definition: Significantly increase access to information and communications technology and strive to provide universal and affordable access to the Internet.

title: Reduced Inequalities
summary: Reduce inequality within and among countries.
target_definition: Ensure equal opportunity and reduce inequalities of outcome, including by eliminating discriminatory laws, policies and practices.

title: Sustainable Cities and Communities
summary: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.
target_definition: Reduce the adverse per capita environmental impact of cities, including by paying special attention to air quality and waste management.

title: Responsible Consumption and Production
summary: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.
target_title: Information and awareness for sustainable lifestyles
target_definition: Ensure that people everywhere have the relevant information and awareness for sustainable development and lifestyles in harmony with nature.

title: Climate Action
summary: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.
target_title: Integrate climate measures into policy and planning
target_definition: Integrate climate change measures into national policies, strategies and planning.

title: Life Below Water
summary: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas and marine resources for sustainable development.
target_definition: Conserve at least 10 per cent of coastal and marine areas, consistent with national and international law and based on the best available scientific information.

title: Life on Land
summary: Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably manage forests, combat desertification, and halt and reverse land degradation and halt biodiversity loss.
target_title: Integrate biodiversity into planning and accounting
target_definition: Integrate ecosystem and biodiversity values into national and local planning, development processes and poverty reduction strategies.

title: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
summary: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels.
target_title: Public access to information and protection of freedoms
target_definition: Ensure public access to information and protect fundamental freedoms, in accordance with national legislation and international agreements.

title: Partnerships for the Goals
summary: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development.
target_definition: Encourage and promote effective public, public-private and civil society partnerships.
